snippet.title: Hope in the City Official Trailer | #TheIndiePremier
snippet.description:
When her parents mysteriously disappear, 17-year-old Hope Song launches an investigation of her own. From the award-winning team behind GDC Pitch-winning Sky of Tides and the Annie Award-nominated Eternal Spring, this narrative mystery combines observation, sketching, and deduction to uncover hidden truths beneath the city's surface.

Developed and published by Lofty Sky Entertainment Inc.
